en: Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a tram running along a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk, stand, and push prams along the sidewalks. Overhead tram wires and shop signs are visible. The lower margin has printed red text identifying the location as Freiberg in Saxony and the specific street as Burgstrasse, along with the publisher credit.
